# Release 1.0.3

- Replace the oversized version dropdown with a bounded, scrollable picker grouped into Stable, Beta, and Pinned releases.
- Distinguish installed and selected releases, with version-aware checkmarks for moving channels.
- Simplify the hero and show installation state, installed version, selected channel, and update availability at a glance.
- Make the primary action reflect the selected release: Install, Update, Reinstall, Install Beta, Switch to Beta, Install selected version, or Repair.
- Clarify installation history when an existing installation has no local install record.
- Improve release notes with spacing, expand/collapse, refresh/cache metadata, and an Open changelog action.
- Show compact game, backend, OpenXR, desktop-entry, and Steam-shortcut indicators while installer details are collapsed.
- Polish spacing, cards, buttons, secondary text, and narrow-window layout.
